name: Users
title: Templates/Platform/Account/Users
summary: The people who can sign in to an account. A `PageHeader` with Documentation and the primary Invite User over the table-view controls row (`PropertyFilter` over name, email, role and status, Refresh and Download CSV as `IconButton`s, `CollectionPreferences`) and a flush `Card` holding a `Table` on one `useCollection`: Name (square `Avatar`, the name or the invited email), Email, Role as a `Tag` (Owner, Admin, Developer, Viewer), Teams as an inline `MultiSelect` per person that applies at once with an Undo toast (disabled for the owner and inactive people), Status as `Table.CellStatus` (Active, Invited, Inactive), Last active as `Table.CellTime` or `Not signed in yet`, and `Table.CellActions` with View profile (a `Dialog` with `KeyValuePairs`), Edit role (a `Dialog` with a role `Select` and an Undo toast), Resend invitation for invited people and Remove from account (or Cancel invitation) behind a `ConfirmDialog`. Invite User opens a large `Drawer` form with Email and a Teams `MultiSelect`, errors after Send, and a toast that names the teams. Built from `PageHeader`, `Button`, `PropertyFilter`, `IconButton`, `Tooltip`, `CollectionPreferences`, `Card`, `Table`, `Avatar`, `Tag`, `MultiSelect`, `DropdownMenu`, `Dialog` and its parts, `KeyValuePairs`, `Select`, `ConfirmDialog`, `Drawer` and its parts, `PanelHeader`, `PanelContent`, `PanelFooter`, `Field`, `Input`, `EmptyState`, `Alert`; its toasts go through `toast` into the app's one toast region (ToastPlugin, or one Toaster at the app root), never a Toaster in the page body. A page body for ConsoleLayout, rendered in its default slot.

variants.name: Invite
variants.summary: The Invite User drawer open over the list: Email and Teams (Developers preselected), Cancel and Send invitation; Send with an empty, malformed or existing email or no team shows the error on that field and focuses it.

variants.name: EditRole
variants.summary: The Edit role dialog open for Jordan Reyes: a role Select (Admin, Developer, Viewer) whose description says what the role allows, Cancel and Save role; saving changes the Role tag and raises a toast with Undo.

variants.name: OnlyOwner
variants.summary: An account with only its owner: the owner's row, then a small EmptyState that invites the first teammate.

variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: The first load: the controls row and the table's loading rows.

variants.name: Failed
variants.summary: The users did not load: a danger Alert with Retry replaces the table; Retry loads them.
